chunks: And from Ghundar from Shu'ba who said: Abu Awanah narrated to us, from Abdul Malik ibn Umayr, from Jabir ibn Samra who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: This religion will remain upright until twelve caliphs will arise. Then he said a word that I did not understand, so I asked my father, and he said: He said: All of them are from Quraysh.
ai.seo_question: Who are the twelve caliphs mentioned in the hadith and what is their tribal origin?
ai.summary: This foundational hadith, widely cited in both Sunni and Shia sources, establishes the number and tribal origin of the twelve legitimate successors, with Shia scholarship specifically identifying them as the Twelve Imams. The clarification that they are all from Quraysh underscores the divine selection within the Prophet's lineage, a key criterion for Imamate in Shia theology. It serves as a primary textual proof for the continuity of spiritual and political authority after the Prophet's death.
